tokens.name: canvas
tokens.usage: Page background in the app and around cards. Never put the logo on it without checking the clear space.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, drawers, tables, inputs. The default ground for the ink logo.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline borders and dividers. Cards rest on a 1px line, not on heavy shadows.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text, the logo on light grounds, primary buttons. 16.4:1 on surface.

tokens.name: ink-2
tokens.usage: Secondary text and body copy on long pages.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Captions, labels, metadata. The lightest text allowed: 4.7:1 on canvas in light, 5.4:1 on surface in dark.

tokens.name: night
tokens.usage: The brand plate: footer, social images, dark hero bands. In the dark theme it is lifted so it reads against the canvas. The white logo lives here.

tokens.name: signal
tokens.usage: The one brand accent: links, focus, the active state, the current step, key chart bars. Use sparingly, about a tenth of any screen.

tokens.name: signal-strong
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed states of signal elements; signal text on tinted grounds.

tokens.name: signal-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted grounds for selected rows, info notices and the signal chip.

tokens.name: sealed
tokens.usage: Success and settled states: Proven, Settled, Verified. Never decorative.

tokens.name: sealed-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of success notices and chips.

tokens.name: caution
tokens.usage: Warnings and states that need attention, such as Needs receipt or Network busy.

tokens.name: caution-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of warning notices.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Errors and refusals only: a blocked payment, a failed step.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of error notices.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Landing hero and campaign headlines. One per page.

styles.name: h1
styles.usage: Section titles on the landing, page titles in the app.

styles.name: h2
styles.usage: Sub sections and large card titles.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.sample: Amounts are sealed on Solana. Only the people you choose can read them.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Your accountant sees every amount in the period you shared.
styles.usage: Default text in the app and documents.

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Table cells, secondary lines, helper text.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Field labels, chips, small headings over figures.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Addresses, signatures, code and anything a person may copy.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to label, chip padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Tight stacks, between a figure and its label.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Inside compact rows and buttons.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Default gap between related elements; small card padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding, gap between cards.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between card groups.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Between page sections in the app.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Page padding on wide screens.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Between landing sections.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Chips, tags, small inputs.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons and inputs.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Menus, notices, small cards.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards and drawers.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Hero cards and large landing panels.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Pills, toggles, avatars.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Cards at rest. Mostly a hairline; depth comes from the canvas and surface contrast.

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: Drawers, menus and the floating glass cards on the landing.
